input.title: Web - Graphic Designer

requirements.text: Professional web and graphic design experience
UX/UI principles, responsive design and accessibility
Designing landing pages, promotional sections and marketing campaigns
Attention to detail, taste and visual storytelling
Illustration or a hand-drawn visual style
Brand strategy and storytelling through design

notes: 'Only resumes in English' is an application rule, not a language requirement. No years: 'we value portfolios over exact years'.
